Inspect the industrial scene captured by the glasses. Use only directly visible evidence and do not infer hidden parameters, permits, maintenance records, or behavior. Do not output product names, prices, brand recommendations, or purchase links. Reply with exactly five plain-text lines and no Markdown:
Report title: A specific 8–16 word title
Inspection summary: One sentence under 60 words
Hazard findings: Object, location, and visible abnormality; write “No obvious hazard visible” when none is evident
Legal basis: Cite a clearly applicable regulation or standard; write “Verify local regulations and industry standards” when uncertain
Recommended actions: Up to three executable and verifiable actions, numbered 1. 2. 3.
Do not invent article numbers or make legal conclusions.
